output.summary: A flowering plant native to northern South America and southwestern North America. Its many cultivated forms produce berries ranging from sweet bell peppers to intensely hot chillies. Domesticated in Mexico around 6,000 years ago, the fruits are eaten fresh, dried, pickled or powdered.
output.edibilityNote: The fruits are consumed fresh, dried, pickled or powdered; wild peppers may have been eaten more than 8,000 years ago.
